reviews.text: Very good vet practice, we’ve been quite a fair bit over the past 6 years with our dog and always had very good experience.
Such a friendly, informative team. Always put my dog at ease as he’s super nervous at the vets but they make the experience as painful free as possible. Highly recommend
Thanks Nick for your kind review
Was seen very quickly. Staff very pleasant and helpful. A relaxed environment for my cat.
Wonderful staff, especially Emma Foster at East Dulwich branch

Hadrian is an amazing vet. My dog is extremely nervous when visiting the vet and his manner is extremely calm and reassuring and it’s been transformative for her and has made the experience so much less stressful for both of us. She has also had some recurrent eye problems which he has dealt with brilliantly.. We very much appreciate the care he takes in dealing with her.
Super clean, calm environment with a friendly, knowledgable team who take ace care of my cat.
A very warm reception and calm caring vets. You feel in very good hands. Saw a particularly lovely vet - Jess - who was attentive and reassuring. A very lovely place to trust with your beloved pets.

Used to be very good but since it was taken over by IVC Evidensia (owned primarily by Private Equity firm EQT) has gone downhill, they overdosed by cat with steroids I moved to another vet and my cat made a significant recovery. Eventually she passed away and although she was no longer registered with the Neighbourhood Vet they continued to contact me about her. Avoid

I’m not one to leave reviews, but I received outstanding service at “Neighbourhood Vets - East Dulwich” earlier today, when I popped in with a cat I rescued, in order to get her chip scanned.

Friendly, welcoming, professional, truly helpful - five-star service all round and you can tell they really care about pets! Thanks again!

We've been customers/clients/patients, I'm not quite sure of the right word (!) for about 8 years now, so it's about time I wrote a review.  From the first interaction way back in 2018, when Rory, a former vet, insisted on giving our two Burmese kittens a quick kiss and cuddle before giving them their vaccinations, to last nights visit with Sean, I simply cannot fault the care and attention that my 3 'girls' have received.  I will probably miss a few people out, but in no particular order:-

Michelle - Previously 'owned' by a lilac Burmese herself, she is such a safe, kind and knowledgeable pair of hands when we we have had to take our two Burmese in for various things over the years. We love her straight talking but extremely compassionate approach, especially when we had anxiety about having both girls in for a teeth extraction.  It was 100% the right thing to do, and we are grateful for her sage advice.

Rhia - Performed the aforementioned extraction on one of our Burmese, not once, but twice.  Super kind and professional, and really put my mind at rest by calling me on both occasions to let me know that Honey was out of surgery and recovering well.

Sean - A truly lovely and knowledgeable vet who saw our cat only last night, after she had been suffering with a 'funny tummy' for about a week.  Really put our mind at rest and gave us the time we needed to understand the situation properly and how best to tackle it, all at the end of what was almost certainly a very long day for him.  All 3 of our girls have seen Sean over the years and I could not recommend him highly enough.

Chris - I cannot thank Chris enough for his kindness and patience with me when we brought a kitten over from Greece after falling in love with her on holiday.  She arrived with quite a few issues, the worst of which was tritrichomonas foetus something I had never heard of and which was extremely hard to shift.  It was a very difficult time and Chris talked me through the medication protocol and managed to get it for me quickly, despite being off-label and not easy to procure.  And like everyone there, just a genuinely lovely guy.

But thanks really must go to everyone at The Neighbourhood Vet as they are always there for whatever we have needed.
Really friendly, professional vet practice! Highly recommend :)

I've owned 3 cats over the last 18 years and have found NHV to be the best vets they've been registered with. Consistently reliable, excellent customer service, compassion and care. Yesterday I needed to book an emergency appointment for my cat and the East Dulwich branch made space for him to be brought in within the hour and the vet who saw my cat was brilliant. NHV is a local vet you can 100% trust. I highly recommend.
Excellent service and professional veterinary advice. Many thanks,  G

I work abroad and have had a very challenging time accessing high quality vet support for my senior dog, coupled with translation issues. I was at my wits end having had 3 different diagnosis and still seeing no improvement so I reached out to neighbourhood vet to ask for their help. Sean has been amazing- I was able to talk through symptoms I’ve been seeing , share test results and videos and finally feel heard and understood. Sean has been super patient and talked through various options with clarity and care. It has been a great experience and my dog is finally more stable and having a better quality of life with the care she is now receiving.

I have never been disappointed with the treatment my dog Jaz receives at NHV. Always a warm welcome from reception,  Emma, Jaz's vet, always explains everything and always makes a big fuss of Jaz when we meet.
I cannot find any faults with the practice at all
Sean was fantastic with my dog today. The staff were doing a fantastic job despite being super busy !!!

Awful practice. Would never recommend. Took my cat here for an emergency and the nurses kept us waiting for long before even seeing her or assessing her. They constantly dismissed me. Felt very unsafe and gaslighted by the team. They didn’t seem to care about her. The care was non compassionate and not pet centred at all.
Really great practice, from the minute you walk in the door, everyone is really lovely .Reception staff are so great a real credit to the practice. Superb service.
Helpful receptionists and excellent care for my dog.  Also easy to book.
Orla was fantastic and gave Carrots a full MOT and brilliant advice and care. Hapoy Rabbit!  Thank you.
My gorgeous yet grumpy Westie Lola was cared for amazingly by Neighbourhood vets but in particular Michelle the vet we saw this last Saturday she is wonderful so a massive - THANK YOU
Many thanks for your review

My cat Pope was well cared for and not stress out
The vet listened and was understanding. My cat Pope had the right treatment and I was given a few tips and the vet was good at finding out what was wrong with Pope.

We have a history with the practice as our previous dog was registered with the practice and we didn't think twice about putting our new dog on their books. The staff are extremely friendly, very professional and above all caring. They always manage to put our boy at ease, which is no mean achievement as he does have anxiety issues. And they never forget to reward his good behaviour with some well deserved treats. We've been with the Neighbourhood Vet for many years and they've always given their best for our pets.

I booked an emergency appointment with them when I noticed my cat was rather poorly, I didn't realise you had to register first so I had to do that and they called me back as soon as they received my registration to get an appointment sorted. The Vet who saw us (Alice) was so wonderful and helpful and really made such a positive difference to an otherwise horribly nerve wracking situation. Highly recommend!
Have been using The Neighbourhood Vet for about 4 years now. Very helpful and friendly staff and always very reassuring.
Miska was seen promptly for an emergency ,booked straight away by the receptionist I spoke to. The vet was excellent with her and the cost was so reasonable . Can’t thank the team enough
I feel confident that my pets are being cared for well and the vet is exceptional
Was able to get an appointment the same day. My cat is improving after treatment for a gastrointestinal issue 24 hours later.

One of three practices, this one, Penge and Crofton Park enabling then to offer seven day a week availability with an out of hours veterinary partner.
They have been fantastic with standard services like vaccinations and innoculations right up to serious emergencies.
The vets in attendance when I've dealt with them have been caring and professional - Recommended!
A warm and friendly welcome both for us and for our pet.  The vet cared for our cat really well, and was both relaxed and thorough.  It was a very positive experience.
Absolutely brilliant - care attention to my dog Bertie  well done to Jess amazing doctor  10/10

I’ve never been to this vets as I’m housebound,My carers take my dog ruby to her appointments and they’ve always come back full of praises for the staff especially the receptionists who make you feel very welcome as soon as you enter. I can only take their word so I’m thanking you very much for such kindness on my behalf.

My cat received excellent care from vets Emma and Jessie, and both of them followed up to check on her after her appointment, which I really appreciated.

..
Jemima went above and beyond to ensure that the documentation was satisfactory for importing my rabbits to Canada. Very grateful, thank you!

I moved from the Neighbourhood Vet after 11 years because I found their new payment policy objectionable: overbearing, hectoring and menacing, esp in my personal circumstances (tied up with hospital visits for blood transfusions), even though they were putting the claim through insurance.
I objected to being harassed in hospital, and being told in front of a packed waiting room that they 'insisted' on payment there and then because we'd completed an insurance form incorrectly. We had been with TNV since Albert was a pup, we'd always paid and they had made significant money from us over the years. It was insulting.
We've moved to a small, friendly practice (Peckham Vets) which reminds me of what TNV used to be like before they sold to a global vets practice and before Simon Knowles left....just as knowledgeable but friendly, relaxed, too.
Also, just discovered that they charge less for prescriptions, and will write more repeats for that fee, meaning I don't have to return more often for more prescriptions.
V smooth and easy.

Dreadful. So many things wrong with this practice.
Theres a receptionist there who ignored is completely for 10 minutes. She was on the phone when we arrived but after completing the call she ignored us choosing to chat with a colleague. Our dogs back legs were paralysed due to a slipped disc something we knew was likely to be the case. She's a dachsund. We had to be referred to a specialist. Vet barely looked at her but they charged us £110 for the phone call. They gave us children's paracetamol which they charged almost £60 for when we discovered it was over the counter medicine at no more than £13 online. It took them 10 months after my dogs operation for them to call about referring her for physio (she'd already been attending hydrotherapy that we arranged) it had taken them that long to check back on her.
They have never been interested in the care of our pet only the money she generates. They are uninterested, indifferent and clearly in completely the wrong profession
To sum up - avoid this practice like the plague. The Neighbourhood vet made its name from being featured in a children's tv documentary series. It seems they played up to the cameras but in reality are a flop as a decent trustworthy carer for you pets.

Obviously you expect excellent medical care; and the Neighbourhood Vet team do that. But the real stars are front and back of house. The reception team are always organised and on top of things. And the insurance specialists have always made life simple with pre-auths. You always feel like you’re in competent and proactive hands. Superb team.
Very expensive and relatively inexperienced vets

We wanted to write this review, even though it has taken us a few months because of the grieving process after losing our beloved 16 year old cat, Milo.

We cannot thank Hadrian enough for the care, compassion and dignity he showed during such a heartbreaking time. From the very beginning, he and the whole team at Neighbourhood Vet Dulwich made us feel completely supported. Everything was handled so seamlessly and gently. We never felt rushed or pressured in any way, including around payment, which meant we could focus entirely on being present with Milo in her final moments.

As a family, we felt truly cared for during one of the most difficult experiences we have ever gone through.

Thank you to Hadrian and the entire team for looking after her with such love and professionalism.

I had a pleasant experience with the Dulwich neighbourhood vet. From start to finish the staffs were attentive. They listened to all of my concerns which made the entire visit stress fee. I left feeling confident that my dog was definitely on the road to a great recovery. Thanks to all the staffs including Dr Anna the veterinarian and Zaina who came over and made the visit to the vet even more pleasurable
100/100 for your service and care.
It's a good vet.

Thank you again, the Neighbourhood vets at Lodship Lane what an impeccable service you provide and a big hooray for our veterinary receptionist that are also impeccable kind understanding service they provide at the front desk again, thank you to all staff and your professionalism my cat fluffy again my tyrant cat is back on the mend and being her normal self again 🫶🫶🫶🫶❤️❤️❤️❤️ update very sad fluffy passed away at home after I came back from the Neighbourhood vet she’s suddenly died at 4:15 on the 11/2/2026 with vascular disease now both my cats are together bam  bam an fluffy  RIP 🙏
What fabulous vets. My dog is a terminal caseband they have been nothing but wonderful.

We moved from East Dulwich a couple years ago and never moved vets. They are worth the 45 minute commute. They are so loving, caring, understanding and above all know how to best care for our crazy fox terriers. We are moving back to the area with them as one of the major pluses. Love them! Nurses and veterinarians are superb!
Woof. I love it here. Woof 🐶 …
Thanks for your kind review. It's much appreciated.

If you are seeking the best clinic for treatment of your pets, you would be hard pressed to find another with standards of excellence like these. I always am amazed by their service provision,  follow ups and professional support and service.
Thanks for your review.
Thanks for your kind review. It means a lot to us.

We had a rescue cat with complex health issues, and thanks to the hard work and dedication of the whole team at the Neighbourhood Vet, we got to have five wonderful years with our beautiful boy. We felt so supported right up to the end and beyond. Would recommend to any pet owner in the area.
Neighbourhood Vets have always been great with our cats. Most recently when both have been wounded in fights, the vet was very sympathetic and helpful and caring.
Warm and friendly welcome, clean and tidy and lovely professionals. Very glad to have The Neighbourhood Vet.

Excellent customer service. Welcoming and friendly staff.
My cat was well looked after and even grew some manners. She didn't even want to leave when I picked her up.
I would definitely recommend.
Passionate vets who really care - we always get the best service here.

Brought a cat here on a Sunday to get checked over as it was very poorly. The receptionist and Vet were very helpful and understanding and although nothing could be done they gave the cat a reassuring check over and I left feeling reassured she would be ok and is currently making a good recovery. I was pleasantly surprised at how helpful and understanding they where, would happily recommend them.
Thanks for your kind review
Were so lovely and looked after our lost cat for us and got her home safely. Thank you team!
Very friendly staff. Brilliant vets everyone makes you and your pets feel very comfortable.

Would definitely recommend this branch of Neighbourhood vets. Lovely staff, relaxing atmosphere and very knowledgeable vet who explained everything and gave us choices of how to proceed with treatment for our cat. Clean and pleasant building.

I finally found the bast vet out there, this vets truly care for my lil Honey <3 Always listen to the problem, never overprescribing or giving several inconclusive appointments to charge more, my dog gets effective care every single time! The service is amazing, the staff is so kind, everyone is lovely. In the two years I have been with the Neighbourhood Vets in Penge I had visits with different vets and everyone of them truly inspected Honey, going beyond the apparent problem and every single time the problem is solved effectively and swiftly. Thank you guys ..
Thanks for your kind review

Neighbourhood Vets have been absolutely exceptional in their care of our cat, Fluffy. From start to finish, the team have been professional, compassionate, and thorough. Rhea and Anna in particular have been wonderful – clear in their explanations, gentle with Fluffy, and genuinely dedicated to her wellbeing.

We are so grateful for the level of care and attention given, and it gives us complete peace of mind knowing Fluffy is in such capable hands. We would highly recommend Neighbourhood Vets to anyone looking for outstanding veterinary care.
Been with this vet for 7 or so years now, We don't know how they find such nice people, the service has always been exceptional. very happy, cheers

Wonderful practice. The staff are so caring, thorough and thoughtful. My cat is terrified of vet visits yet they take their time and are very patient with her. I'm very lucky to have this practice nearby and I would clone them if I could!

I never leave reviews for anything,  ever! But yesterday we had to say goodbye to our old lovely boy Coby a 16 yr old dog that we've loved for over 14 years, it was done so well by neighbourhood vets in east dulwich. We were given time, explained the whole process and with such tenderness and care. Thank you ❣️

Wonderful vets. I've been using the Neighbourhood Vet for over 10 years now and would never go anywhere else. The standard of care and professionalism is unmatched, the consulting rooms and waiting area are spotless and thoughtfully designed (eg. dedicated cat area so they're not scared by dogs) and, most importantly,  every vet I've seen has been incredibly caring and knowledgeable. Would wholeheartedly recommend to anybody living in the area.

Our 5-year-old chihuahua never had any anal gland issues until I received a message from The Neighbourhood Vet in the East Dulwich branch, saying they had booked a time for my dog to get its anal glands checked. Sure, it's my responsibility as a dog owner, and I should have stayed it, but like an idiot, I relied on the vets.
The nurse was smiling as usual, making small talk, and was super polite while sticking her not-so-small finger into the tiny anus of my 2.5 kg dog. The vet's conclusion? That the glands were "excellent!" and that we needed to have them checked every month. The cost for that check was £30.00.
guess what happened next? My dog started having problems with its glands. Today's visit cost a whopping £165.00, and I have to thank my older son, who dropped everything to take the dog to the clinic while we're on vacation. But the real problem is that our dog is suffering. I hope this doesn't become a chronic issue.
I understand that everything's about money these days, but not to this extent. I don't absolve myself of responsibility, because my dog can't read or do research.
